lines.text: Customer! Come, come! I'll do you good price!
Fine fresher, come! First buy is for luck!
Sannu da zuwa! [Welcome!] What do you need?
Thank you, customer! Come back. Don't go to that other one.
No. My price has children. They need to eat.
Ah! You want to buy it at 1990 price?
Rain! Cover the tomatoes! Customers can swim!
Light don go! [Power's gone!] Candle! Torch! Rechargeable fan!
Batteries went up this morning. Don't ask me why. I just feel things.
No change. Bring change, I'll give you change.
Transfer? Network says 'pending'. Me, I say cash.
Tomatoes! Pepper! Onions that will make you cry with joy!
Pure water, cold! Ice-cold! Okay, cool. Reasonably cool.
Last price? This one is the last price's last price.
Garri white, garri yellow, garri for exam, garri for strike!
You want discount? Go and ask NEPA for discount first.
Recharge card! Data! Network is not my department.
Hot akara! Hot! Okay, warm. Come before it's cool.
Suya don ready! [Suya is ready!] Yaji is free. Regret is extra.
Indomie and egg! Two eggs if you greet me well.
I'm closing! I'm closing! …Okay, what do you want?
Candles are moving faster than bread this year.
Light goes, candle money comes. I'm not happy. I'm honest.
The mall sells the same thing at double. With air-conditioning.
They go to the mall to look, then come here to buy.
They say the mall never blinks. My stall blinks every evening.
Escalator this, escalator that. Can escalator sell you ugu?
Mall security asked me for a permit. To walk past.
Strike? Market is fuller than ever. Everybody is a trader now.
Students selling to students. Who is buying? Me, I'm watching.
Sapa combo: garri, sugar, groundnut. Strike price.
One boy asked for credit till the strike ends. I said, which year?
Did you hear? They said the Plug Store is closing. They said. Who is 'they'?
Every customer wants to film the bargain. Oya, film my price too.
Campaign people took my pure water. Free water, paid by me? No.
Five years you've been buying from me. Go and graduate. Come back rich.
My first customer is finishing. I'll cry. After you pay.
The market has more lights now. Somebody fixed something. God bless them.
Fresher! Bucket, mattress, padlock, I have everything. And patience.
Welcome to campus! Your first bucket is from me. At a price.
Brain Booster Tea! You'll remember everything. Even your debts.
Allowance day! Everybody remembers my name today.
It's Thursday! Everything is moving! Hold your bag!
Market day price is today price. Tomorrow price is a different story.
Pickpockets are also shopping today. Keep your phone in front.
Strike again. My customers are home. My tomatoes are not.
Groundnut for the match! It's how they place bets here.
Posters on my stall again. Who will pay for my paint?
Gown photos! Flowers! Small chops! Convocation is our Christmas.
Dates! Kunu! Kosai! [Bean cakes!] Before sunset, please!
Christmas chicken! Christmas lights! Who is travelling?
Red balloon, red rose, red face. Valentine is good business.
Vaseline! Lip balm! Harmattan is here and so am I!
